skills.content:
---
name: bot-purge-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Bot Purge template, to
  set up X follower cleanup.
---
I remove obvious bot, scam, and thirst-trap followers from your X account, then run a weekly check on new followers and tell you how many I removed.

Ask one at a time:
1. What's your X handle? Then have my browser open x.com; if it isn't signed in, walk the owner through signing in (use the sign-in skill).
2. Any accounts or kinds of accounts I should never remove, beyond the defaults (verified accounts and anything that could plausibly be a real person are always kept)?
3. What day and time works for the weekly check? Default to Monday morning in their timezone.

Then: save the handle and any extra rules to memory, fill in the handle and time in the weekly purge routine, and start the first full cleanup right away (it can take a while and X may rate-limit; if so, schedule a one-time follow-up run a few hours later). Report only the count and a one-line summary of what kinds of accounts were removed.

routines.name: Weekly X follower bot purge
routines.description: Fires weekly to remove obvious bot and scam accounts among new X followers and report the count.
routines.content:
The owner asked me to purge obvious bot and scam followers from their X account and wants it done, not a list for them to review. Their account is @<owner's X handle> (followers at https://x.com/<owner's X handle>/followers). Using my signed-in browser on their X account, review the followers who are new since the last run (the newest at the top; go down until reaching accounts already reviewed in earlier runs, or the whole list if unsure), judging each actual profile individually, never by handle or keyword pattern-matching alone. Only touch cells in the real followers list, never "Who to follow" suggestions. NEVER remove any verified account (any blue, gold, or gray verification checkmark), no matter what its profile looks like. Remove (row's More menu, "Remove this follower", confirm; never mute, block, report, unfollow, post, like, or DM) only unverified accounts that are obviously one of: thirst-trap/romance-scam accounts posting sexy photos with DM-me come-ons; accounts linking to adult/NSFW sites (OnlyFans, Fansly, adult link hubs, "18+"; top priority); clear scams such as celebrity/Elon impersonators, lottery-winner giveaways, crypto/forex/investment-mentor pitches, asset-recovery or spell-caster scams, fake military/doctor romance profiles; or plainly empty bots. A digit-heavy handle, a short generic bio, a political bio, or a parody label alone is never enough; if an account could plausibly be a real person, leave it alone. If X isn't signed in, tell the owner in this chat that they need to sign back in and stop. If X rate-limits, wait and retry a few times, then finish what's possible. Tell the owner in this chat how many followers were removed this week. If none, send one short line saying the weekly check found nothing to remove.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Phoenix 0 10 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
